subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.------EXP.INFO.B.
description: Chart on book p. 48 (BK(NM)-24). ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) is the subject; EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis) is the partner. From the subject: EXT-FT (extended functionalism), LG-DY (logical dynamics) and TRS (transition). From EXT-FT: MT-RT-SIGN. From MT-RT-SIGN: VT-SCI and P-FC (particular focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From LG-DY: RE-ST (restructuralism). From RE-ST: TR (transformation). From TRS: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics).
